summary: P14 'Riwayat Perubahan' end-to-end verification (backend + frontend) plus P14 UAT smoke (AUTH-06/MASTER-06/COMM-06/HR-06/OPS-06). Full repo regression (run_p14.py) 24 modules all green including p14=19/19. New pytest file test_p14_history.py (4 tests) all pass against live preview URL: admin sees audit resource endpoint, sales gets 403, GL account create+patch+delete produces diff Lama->Baru with integrity ok, HR employee base_salary PATCH yields diff entry {masked:true, from/to:'[REDACTED]'} and no plaintext leak. Frontend COA & Customer-360 history flows work end-to-end: ?view=chart-of-accounts opens coa-detail-modal with tabs coa-detail-tab-info / coa-detail-tab-history, coa-history panel + coa-history-empty for untouched accounts; editing an account via coa-edit-<code>/coa-edit-name/coa-edit-save adds coa-history-row-<id> with -from-name (struck) / -to-name, -integrity 'Utuh', -layer 'Template global'; coa-history-only-changes and coa-history-refresh render; name reverted. Customer-360 panel shows customer-360-tab-changes to admin, hidden for sales (customer-360-panel still renders). UAT smoke results captured below.

AUTH-06.evidence: entity-switcher present on all pages; menu exposes entity-option-ent_ksc / entity-option-ent_kanda / entity-option-ent_7bccde2a5ba2 and entity-option-all; URL ?entity=<id> is honoured after refresh and data stays scoped (Sukacita badge shown in topbar).

MASTER-06.evidence: ?view=md-products search input narrows list ('endek' -> 3 of 3), pagination control rendered (1/1, Sebelumnya/Berikutnya). KNSelect pattern (<testid>-option-<value>) available on dropdowns.

COMM-06.evidence: Customer list has search input; typing non-matching string surfaces Indonesian empty-state keywords ('tidak ada', 'belum ada'); Export button present.

HR-06.evidence: manager@ reaches ?view=hr-employees and sees full table (18 rows) with 'Gaji Pokok' values visible (Rp 5.000.000, Rp 3.800.000, ...), consistent with manager having both hr.view and hr.view_pii. finance@ is routed to Meja Finance (no HR access). Could not probe a role with hr.view but WITHOUT hr.view_pii from available accounts; backend-side masking is confirmed by test_hr_base_salary_masked (audit diff is [REDACTED]).
HR-06.action: Optional: provide a demo user with hr.view only (no hr.view_pii) so PII redaction in UI can be verified visually.

OPS-06.evidence: Desktop 1920 renders full sidebar + topbar + content. Mobile 390 shell loads with bottom tabbar (Persetujuan/Notifikasi/Antrean/Ringkas/Produk/Tanya), header 'Halo, Budi · Sukacita'. No blank page.

action_items: Add data-testid to Customer Edit modal PIC-name input (e.g. customer-edit-pic_name) and save button (customer-edit-save) so automated history-diff tests can edit customer PIC and verify customer-360-changes rows with -from-pic_name/-to-pic_name. Currently my Playwright edit of pic_name did not fire because the input has no testid; the panel + empty state + tab visibility were still verified.
(Optional) Seed a role scenario user (e.g. accountant@) with hr.view but WITHOUT hr.view_pii so HR-06 PII masking UI can be visually asserted.
critical_code_review_comments: Audit history endpoint response shape is consistent {total, truncated, items[]} with diff[] + integrity + layer_entity_id + scope_entity_name; HR masking is enforced at write-time in audit() (good - no plaintext in persisted audit log).
GL account edit flow stores from/to for 'name' and labels layer correctly ('Template global' for base template, override shows PT name) — matches spec.
Customer-360 'Riwayat Perubahan' tab is correctly gated behind audit.view permission on frontend (hidden for sales@) and backend returns 403 on the API — defense in depth confirmed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core P14 flows; HR-06 PARTIAL (role unavailable)

In UI, edited GL account 6-9500 name 'Rugi Pelepasan Aset Tetap' -> 'TEST_P14_Rugi Pelepasan Aset Tetap' and reverted to original. HR employee base_salary PATCH set to 7777000 then reverted in the same test. No orphan test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P14 'Riwayat Perubahan' is production-ready: backend audit resource API + GL + HR masking + frontend COA/Customer-360 history panels all verified. Entity-switcher option testid pattern is 'entity-option-<entity_id>' (NOT 'entity-switcher-option-<id>'). Customer edit modal lacks data-testids on individual fields — if you want to drive a customer PIC edit from Playwright, you'll need to target label-adjacent inputs (e.g. first input after 'Nama PIC Toko') or ask main agent to add testids. Regression driver: cd /app/backend && python ../audit/iterations/2026-10-02-P14-coverage-uat/run_p14.py (or --only=p14).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only one minor testability gap (Customer Edit modal fields lacking data-testid) which does not affect functionality.
